panel_activity_action_failed: Title of an Activity row: an action ended with an error. {label} is the action's name.
panel_activity_action_finished: Title of an Activity row: an action ended well. {label} is the action's name.
panel_activity_action_started: Title of an Activity row: an action started. {label} is the action's name.
panel_activity_drawer_activity: Tooltip (title attribute) of a <DrawerShell> component, in ActivityDrawer (apps/desktop/src/lib/panel/ActivityDrawer.svelte). Extracted by i18n:extract: refine this description on review.
panel_activity_drawer_filter_activity: Accessible name (aria-label, read by screen readers) of a <ToggleGroup> component, in ActivityDrawer (apps/desktop/src/lib/panel/ActivityDrawer.svelte). Extracted by i18n:extract: refine this description on review.
panel_activity_drawer_heavy_jobs: Accessible name (aria-label, read by screen readers) of a <section> element, in ActivityDrawer (apps/desktop/src/lib/panel/ActivityDrawer.svelte). Extracted by i18n:extract: refine this description on review.
panel_activity_empty_hint: Description of the empty Activity drawer.
panel_activity_events_over: Tooltip of the ×N badge of a folded Activity row. {count} is at least 2; {span} is a compact duration ("3m").

panel_activity_filter_all.description: Option of the Activity filter that shows every row.
panel_activity_filter_all.distinct: agrees with the activity rows (masculine); the other filters 'tarefas' (feminine)

panel_activity_heavy_busy: Summary of the machine-wide heavy job queue when nothing waits. {running} slots are in use of {slots}.
panel_activity_heavy_busy_waiting: Summary of the heavy job queue when jobs wait. {queued} is the number of waiting jobs.
panel_activity_heavy_jobs_summary: Header of the heavy jobs list in the Activity and Machine drawers. {summary} is the queue summary line.
panel_activity_heavy_running: Detail of a running heavy job. {age} is a compact duration ("1m05s"). i18n-allow glossary:project
panel_activity_heavy_running_eta: Detail of a running heavy job whose end history can estimate. {eta} is a compact duration. i18n-allow glossary:project
panel_activity_heavy_waiting: Detail of a queued heavy job. {age} is a compact duration. i18n-allow glossary:project
panel_activity_heavy_waiting_eta: Detail of a queued heavy job whose start history can estimate. {eta} is a compact duration. i18n-allow glossary:project
panel_activity_n_times: Detail of an Activity row that folded identical alerts. {count} is at least 2.
panel_activity_no_activity_yet: Title of the empty Activity drawer.
panel_activity_nothing_matches: Title of the Activity drawer when the filter hides every row.
panel_activity_now_state: Detail of a restart row: the state the service settled in. {state} is a state word (stopped, failed...).
panel_activity_open_service_logs: Tooltip of an Activity row. {service} is the service name; {time} is a clock time. i18n-allow glossary:service
panel_activity_restarted: Title of an Activity row for one restart. i18n-allow glossary:service
panel_activity_restarted_n: Title of an Activity row for several restarts in one burst. {count} is at least 2. i18n-allow glossary:service
panel_activity_try_another_filter: Description of the Activity drawer when the filter hides every row.
